QuestInfo.name: [Party Quest] Cross World Party Quest
QuestInfo.0:
All sorts of Party Quests await in the Cross World area! They change every two weeks, so there's always something new to do! Get to the #rCross World Area#k via Spiegelmann's guest house, and play with adventurers from other worlds!


- #eRecommended Level#n: 70+

- #eTime Limit#n: 20 minutes

- #eParty Size#n: 4

- #eRoute#n: Take the Dimensional Mirror to get to the Cross World Area via Spiegelmann's Guest House. Or take the Dimensional Mirror directly to the Cross World Area

- #eFinal Reward#n: EXP and Party Points that can be used to purchase various items from the Pub
